_comment: GB300 L10 MGX (system10) — physical cabling verified 2026-10-16 by RDMA traffic:
NOTE (v1.0.5): rdma_test_ipv4_v4.py / rdma_test_ipv6_v5.py use their own validated
built-in topology (pairs + card type + GPU map + wave schedule) and do NOT read this file.
The menu 'd' auto-discovery uses ping, which always succeeds between NICs on the
same host, so it can produce wrong pairs (e.g. mlx5_0<->mlx5_1). Do not trust it on L10.
